C:P1.4.text: Game-changing people, process and productivity move more than product. We move results.

C:P1.6.text: Distribution Solutions Group (DSG) is a best-in-class specialty distribution company providing high-touch, value-added distribution solutions to the Maintenance, Repair and Operations (MRO), Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and the industrial technologies markets. DSG was formed through the strategic combination of Lawson Products, a leader in MRO and C-parts distribution, Gexpro Services, a leading global supply chain services provider to the OEM market, and TestEquity, a leader in electronic test and measurement solutions.

C:P1.7.text: Through its collective businesses, DSG is dedicated to being a one-stop solution provider and helping customers lower their total cost of operation by increasing productivity and efficiency with the right products, expert technical support and fast, reliable delivery. DSG ships from strategically located distribution and service centers to customers in North America, Europe, Asia, South America and the Middle East.

C:P1.8.text: Lawson Products sells and distributes specialty products to the industrial, commercial, institutional and government maintenance, repair and operations markets through Lawson Products, Partsmaster, Bolt Supply House, and Kent Automotive. The company is dedicated to helping customers in the U.S. and Canada lower their total cost of operation by increasing productivity and efficiency.

C:P1.9.text: Gexpro Services is a leading global supply chain solutions and mission-critical C-parts provider lowering the total cost of production for blue-chip manufacturing customers through vendor-managed inventory, kitting, strategic sourcing and global logistics. Gexpro Services is uniquely positioned to deliver rapid improvements in fulfillment as well as process and product quality.

C:P1.10.text: TestEquity is the largest, most comprehensive provider of test solutions proudly supporting the aerospace, defense, automotive, electronics, education, and medical industries. Through its brands: TestEquity, Techni-Tool, and Jensen, the company stocks the most components to help design and build electronics, with the understanding that highly specialized technology demands highly personalized service.

C:P1.11.text: A team of distribution, industry and business leaders apply their combined expertise to help DSG customers leverage their supply chain as a competitive advantage – from mission-critical strategies to day-to-day supply.

C:P1.12.text: As a resource that delivers tangible products as well as logistical solutions, Distribution Solutions Group sees the opportunities from sustainable operations via multiple viewpoints.
